questions.question: What is a country? Give three things that a country has.
questions.expected_answer: A country is an area of land with its own government, laws and citizens. A country also has its own flag, national anthem and currency.

questions.question: Name South Africa's three capital cities and the job of each.
questions.expected_answer: Pretoria is where the President and government departments work, at the Union Buildings. Cape Town is where Parliament meets to make laws. Bloemfontein is where the Supreme Court of Appeal sits.

questions.question: Give two examples of borders in Africa that follow natural features.
questions.expected_answer: The Limpopo River forms the border between South Africa and Zimbabwe. Lake Victoria is shared by Uganda, Kenya and Tanzania, with the borders running across the water. The Gariep or Orange River forms part of the border between South Africa and Namibia.
